description: Standard Frame: (item_vp * 2) * vp_rate. 40+ products (MP_P85_ABL, MP_WC, MP_KABDV 등). Excel: ((item_vp+item_vp)*vp_rate)
formula: (item_vp + item_vp) * vp_rate

description: Complex Double Glazed Frame (KDV): body+clch+base scaled by width/ch + joints scaled by ch/buffer. Excel Row 6 MP_KDV3030
formula: ((item_vp + clch_vp + base_vp) * vp_rate / (width / 1000) / (stnd_ch / 1000) + ((joint_vp * 2) + joint_vp * 2) * vp_rate / (stnd_ch / 1000) / buffer_rate) * mat_rate

description: Complex Single Glazed Frame (KSVO/KSVC): joint calculation differs - uses (stnd_ch/1000) multiplier. Excel MP_KSVO3030, MP_KSVC_N
formula: ((item_vp + clch_vp + base_vp) * vp_rate / (width / 1000) / (stnd_ch / 1000) + (joint_vp * (stnd_ch / 1000) + joint_vp) * vp_rate / (stnd_ch / 1000) / buffer_rate) * mat_rate

description: Complex DG Frame with panel VP (KDV + panel). Pricing Variables: panel_vp, hbar_qty(가로바수량), margin_factor(여유). Excel Row 11 MP_KDV3030
formula: ((item_vp + panel_vp * hbar_qty * (width / 1000) * margin_factor + clch_vp + base_vp) * vp_rate / (width / 1000) / (stnd_ch / 1000) + ((joint_vp * 2) + joint_vp * 2) * vp_rate / (stnd_ch / 1000) / buffer_rate) * mat_rate

description: Complex SG Frame with panel VP (KSVO + panel). Pricing Variables: panel_vp, hbar_qty, margin_factor. Excel Row 12 MP_KSVO3030
formula: ((item_vp + panel_vp * hbar_qty * (width / 1000) * margin_factor + clch_vp + base_vp) * vp_rate / (width / 1000) / (stnd_ch / 1000) + (joint_vp * (stnd_ch / 1000) + (joint_vp / buffer_rate) + joint_vp * (hbar_qty + 1)) * vp_rate / (stnd_ch / 1000) / buffer_rate) * mat_rate

description: Door products (31+): active_leaf_vp + inactive_leaf_vp + opt_cost from VP Management/Pricing Variables. Excel: (item_vp(ACT)+item_vp(INA)+OPT)*vp_rate
formula: (active_leaf_vp + inactive_leaf_vp + opt_cost) * vp_rate

description: Accessory/UPAS: item_vp scaled by buffer only. Excel: MP_UPAS_KR
formula: item_vp * vp_rate / buffer_rate

description: Accessory with glass (AS type): frame + glass component. Pricing Variables: glass_cost_component, glass_area_ratio. Excel: MP_AS_KR, MP_FG*_AS_*
formula: item_vp * vp_rate / (stnd_ch / 1000) / buffer_rate + ((clch_vp + base_vp) * vp_rate / (width / 1000) / (stnd_ch / 1000) / buffer_rate) * mat_rate + glass_cost_component * glass_area_ratio * glass_rate * glass_surcharge

description: Operable Wall/PC: body+joint + clch/base scaled by PC UW. Pricing Variables: joint_cost(=17*3=51 등). Excel: MP_PC, MP_PC_KR
formula: (item_vp + joint_cost) * vp_rate + ((clch_vp / (width / 1000) * pc_uw / 1000) + (base_vp / (width / 1000) * pc_uw / 1000)) * vp_rate * mat_rate

description: Sliding Single (FSDU): body+extras + clch scaled by S_UW. Pricing Variables: glass_attach, joint_cost. Excel: MP_FSDU_*, MP_DGSDU_*, MP_SGSDU_*
formula: (item_vp + glass_attach + joint_cost) * vp_rate + clch_vp * vp_rate / (width / 1000) * mat_rate * s_uw / 1000

description: Sliding Pair (FPDU): body+extras + clch scaled by P_UW. Pricing Variables: glass_attach, joint_cost. Excel: MP_FPDU_*, MP_DGPDU_*, MP_SGPDU_*
formula: (item_vp + glass_attach + joint_cost) * vp_rate + clch_vp * vp_rate / (width / 1000) * mat_rate * p_uw / 1000

description: Simple Single Sliding (C2V40, C2SG): body+extras + clch scaled by S_S_UW. Pricing Variables: glass_attach, joint_cost.
formula: (item_vp + glass_attach + joint_cost) * vp_rate + clch_vp * vp_rate / (width / 1000) * mat_rate * s_s_uw / 1000

description: Simple Pair Sliding (C2V40_P, C2SG_P): body+extras + clch scaled by P_S_UW. Pricing Variables: glass_attach, joint_cost.
formula: (item_vp + glass_attach + joint_cost) * vp_rate + clch_vp * vp_rate / (width / 1000) * mat_rate * p_s_uw / 1000

description: Floor Glass Door (FGD): (item_vp*2 + glass_attach)*vp_rate + glass_extra_cost) * surcharge. Pricing Variables: glass_attach, glass_extra_cost. Excel: MP_FGD40T
formula: (((item_vp + item_vp + glass_attach) * vp_rate) + glass_extra_cost) * glass_surcharge

description: All-in-one leaf formula (C2SG_3M_LEAF): all components in single calc. Excel: MP_C2SG_3M_LEAF
formula: (item_vp + clch_vp + base_vp + glass_cost_a + glass_cost_b + joint_vp) * vp_rate

description: Glass cost - Double Glazed: (glass_a + glass_b) * glass_rate. Excel: MP_KDV3030
formula: (glass_cost_a + glass_cost_b) * glass_rate

description: Glass cost - Single Glazed: glass_a * glass_rate. Excel: MP_KSVO3030
formula: glass_cost_a * glass_rate

description: Door glass - Single leaf, full height AG. Pricing Variables: glass_unit_cost (=glass_cost_a_8T), glass_process_cost. Uses s_lh, s_lw derived fields.
formula: glass_unit_cost * s_lh * s_lw * glass_rate / 1000000 + glass_process_cost

description: Door glass - Single leaf, DG (8T+6T). Pricing Variables: glass_unit_cost_a (=8T), glass_unit_cost_b (=6T), glass_process_cost.
formula: (glass_unit_cost_a + glass_unit_cost_b) * s_lh * s_lw * glass_rate / 1000000 + glass_process_cost

description: Door glass - Single leaf, half-height (HG, center rail deducted). Uses s_lh - crh for height.
formula: glass_unit_cost * (s_lh - crh) * s_lw * glass_rate / 1000000 + glass_process_cost

description: Door glass - Single leaf, vision panel (V type, fixed 200mm height). Uses s_lh * 200.
formula: glass_unit_cost * s_lh * 200 * glass_rate / 1000000 + glass_process_cost

description: Door glass - Pair leaf, full height AG. Uses p_lw + p_s_lw for both panels.
formula: glass_unit_cost * s_lh * p_lw * glass_rate / 1000000 + glass_unit_cost * s_lh * p_s_lw * glass_rate / 1000000 + glass_process_cost

description: Door glass - Pair leaf, DG (8T+6T). Uses p_lw + p_s_lw.
formula: (glass_unit_cost_a + glass_unit_cost_b) * s_lh * p_lw * glass_rate / 1000000 + (glass_unit_cost_a + glass_unit_cost_b) * s_lh * p_s_lw * glass_rate / 1000000 + glass_process_cost

description: Sliding DG glass - conditional on (CH-LH), Single S_UW. Excel: MP_DGSDU_*
Sliding SG glass - conditional on (CH-LH), Single S_UW. Excel: MP_SGSDU_*
Sliding DG glass - conditional on (CH-LH), Pair P_UW. Excel: MP_DGPDU_*
Sliding SG glass - conditional on (CH-LH), Pair P_UW. Excel: MP_SGPDU_*
Installation cost - basic CH conditional. For frame products (KDV, KSVO etc). Excel: IF ch<3: inst_cost/ch else: inst_cost*surcharge/ch
Installation cost - CH conditional + S_UW width scaling. For single sliding units (FSDU). Excel: inst_cost * round(S_UW/1000) / 2
Installation cost - CH conditional + P_UW width scaling. For pair units (FPDU). Excel: inst_cost * round(P_UW/1800) / 2
Installation cost - CH conditional + S_S_UW scaling. For simple single units (C2V40, C2SG).
Installation cost - CH conditional + P_S_UW scaling. For simple pair units (C2V40_P, C2SG_P).
Installation cost - simple CH conditional (PC, accessory). Excel: IF ch<3: inst_cost else: inst_cost*1.15
Cleaning cost - unit width based (sliding/pair). Pricing Variable: unit_width. Excel: 15000*UW/1000/2
Cleaning cost - CH divided by 6 (frame products). Excel: 200000/6/ch. 시운!L10=200000
Caulking cost - CH divided by 10. Excel: 300000/10/ch. 시운!L11=300000
Caulking cost - CH divided by 20. For doors/accessories.
Transportation cost: expense_rate / ch / 13 / 2. For DG frames. Excel: 180000/ch/13/2. 시운!M30=180000
formula: expense_rate / (stnd_ch / 1000) / 13 / 2

description: Transportation cost: expense_rate / ch / 13. For most SG frames, doors. Excel: 180000/ch/13
formula: expense_rate / (stnd_ch / 1000) / 13

description: Transportation cost: expense_rate / ch / 8. For doors and sliding units.
formula: expense_rate / (stnd_ch / 1000) / 8

description: Waste disposal cost: (factory + glass) * other_rate. Excel: (aa10+ac40)*other_rate. For most products.
formula: (aa10_result + ac40_result) * other_rate

description: Waste disposal cost: half rate. For doors/accessories. Excel: (aa10+ac40)*other_rate/2
formula: (aa10_result + ac40_result) * other_rate / 2

description: Contingency cost: (factory + install + cleaning + caulking) * other_rate. Excel: (aa10+ab20+ab44+ac33)*other_rate
formula: (aa10_result + ab20_result + ab44_result + ac33_result) * other_rate

description: Contingency cost: half rate. For doors/accessories.
formula: (aa10_result + ab20_result + ab44_result + ac33_result) * other_rate / 2

description: PM Reserve: 7% of all cost subtotals. Excel: sum(aa10~ad41)*7%. Universal for all products.
formula: (aa10_result + ac40_result + ab20_result + ab44_result + ac33_result + ab30_result + ac34_result + ad43_result + ad41_result) * 0.07

description: Royalty: 4% of all cost subtotals. Excel: sum(aa10~ad41)*4%. Universal for all products.
formula: (aa10_result + ac40_result + ab20_result + ab44_result + ac33_result + ab30_result + ac34_result + ad43_result + ad41_result) * 0.04
